newsitem.title: USA: VECTRA sees fabrication restarting in May.
newsitem.headline: VECTRA sees fabrication restarting in May.

text.p: VECTRA Technologies Inc said Friday it had responded to a demand for more information from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission and foresees taking its fabrication activities off hold in May.

VECTRA, which put fabrication for its nuclear material transportation and storage technologies on hold in January after the Commission requested more information, said it had also completed an independent assessment of those activities.

"We are now working diligently to complete the actions we identified as required for restart, and we anticipate removing our hold on fabrication activities during May," the company said in a statement.
The company leases equipment to store and transport radioactive waste and nuclear material.
